name: History's Repetition (5-6)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean

disable: DC 25 Thievery check (trained) to pick apart the pebbles, or DC 21 Warfare-lore check (trained) to recognize and recreate the battle

items.name: Crushing Hand
items.text:
Trigger Three or more creatures enter the submerged passage

---
Effect The hand reenacts its final battle against the invading demon. It makes a crushing power Strike against all creatures in the passage.

text: Pebbles form into a hand the size of an ox, which reaches to crush anyone in the water.
